<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Implement a pulse detect module.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="s0">0. Initial state. A state waiting for pulse 0.</enum>
        <enum id="s1">1. A state waiting for pulse 1.</enum>
        <enum id="s2">2. A state waiting for pulse 0.</enum>
        <enum id="s3">3. A state waiting for pulse 1.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level1" type="sequencial_logic">sequencial logic.</sequencial>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level2" type="sequencial_logic">sequencial logic.</sequencial>
        <combinational id="data_out" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic.</combinational>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level1">
            <description>sequencial logic. If rst_n is inactive, pulse_level1 is reset to 0. Otherwise, pulse_level1 is set to pulse_level2.</description>
            <sequencial_logic_operation>
                if (!rst_n) begin
                    pulse_level1 <= s0;
                end else begin
                    pulse_level1 <= pulse_level2;
                end
            </sequencial_logic_operation>
        </sequencial>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2">
            <description>combinational logic. In case pulse_level1 is s0, if data_in is 0, pulse_level2 is set to s1, else pulse_level2 is set to s0. In case pulse_level1 is s1, if data_in is 1, pulse_level2 is set to s2, else pulse_level2 is set to s1. In case pulse_level1 is s2, if data_in is 0, pulse_level2 is set to s3, else pulse_level2 is set to s0. In case pulse_level1 is s3, if data_in is 1, pulse_level2 is set to s2, else pulse_level2 is set to s1.</description>
            <combinational_logic_operation>
                if (pulse_level1 == s0) begin
                    if (data_in == 0) begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s1;
                    end else begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s0;
                    end
                end else if (pulse_level1 == s1) begin
                    if (data_in == 1) begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s2;
                    end else begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s1;
                    end
                end else if (pulse_level1 == s2) begin
                    if (data_in == 0) begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s3;
                    end else begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s0;
                    end
                end else if (pulse_level1 == s3) begin
                    if (data_in == 1) begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s2;
                    end else begin
                        pulse_level2 <= s1;
                    end
                end
            </combinational_logic_operation>
        </combinational>
        <combinational id="data_out">
            <description>combinational logic. In the reset condition (~rst_n), set the state register to the initial state and set the data_out output to 0, indicating no pulse. Otherwise, the indicating signal data_out is 1 if pulse_level2 reaches s2 and data_in is 0. Otherwise, returns to 0 until the corresponding pulse appears again.</description>
            <combinational_logic_operation>
                if (~rst_n) begin
                    data_out <= 0;
                end else begin
                    if (pulse_level2 == s2 && data_in == 0) begin
                        data_out <= 1;
                    end else begin
                        data_out <= 0;
                    end
                end
            </combinational_logic_operation>
        </combinational>
    </implementation>
</module>
